Payment cycles are likewise given as typical, to be verified.

claims.claim: Israeli VAT is 18% (since 1 January 2025). Delivery menu price formula: Menu Price = target net revenue / (1 - commission rate), then x1.18 for VAT. Packaging/delivery cost typically 3-8 NIS per order. Prices are in NIS, rounded to whole shekels on delivery platforms.
claims.raw_snippet: והוא עומד החל מיום 01.01.2025 על 18% ממחיר הרכישה / השירות

claims.claim: Israeli statutory food temperatures for a בית אוכל: unfrozen bacteria-friendly food not above 5°C (תקנה 50(א)); frozen food and raw ground meat not above minus 18°C (תקנה 50(ב)); food served hot held at at least 65°C until served (תקנה 51(א)); thawing in a place not above 10°C (תקנה 47); after cooking, centre temperature not above 20°C at one hour and not above 5°C at two hours (תקנה 51(ב)); cold-room recording thermometer accurate to ±0.5°C (תקנה 21); a grease separator installed per the director's instructions.
claims.raw_snippet: מאכל המיועד להגשה כמאכל חם יוחזק בטמפרטורה של 65 מעלות צלזיוס לפחות, עד למסירתו לידי הסועד

claims.claim: Target food-cost percentages by restaurant type (fast food 25-30%, casual 28-35%, fine dining 30-40%, delivery-only 25-32%) and the Stars/Puzzles/Plowhorses/Dogs menu-engineering matrix are industry management conventions, not figures set by any Israeli authority.
claims.source_url: self-asserted (industry management convention, no regulatory source)
claims.raw_snippet: Industry food-cost targets: fast/street 25-30%, casual 28-35%, fine dining 30-40%, cloud kitchen 25-32%. Menu engineering: Stars, Puzzles, Plowhorses, Dogs.

claims.claim: Unfrozen food that is a good medium for bacterial growth is held at not above 5°C, and frozen food and raw ground meat at not above minus 18°C (תקנה 50).

claims.claim: Food cooled after cooking must reach not above 20°C at the centre one hour after cooking and not above 5°C two hours after (תקנה 51(ב)).

claims.claim: Under חוק איסור הונאה בכשרות §3(א) the owner of a בית אוכל may not present it in writing as kosher unless a kashrut certificate has been given, and §3(ב) bars a certified kosher-presented establishment from serving or selling items not covered by a certificate. (סעיף 3).

claims.claim: The penalty for an offence under sections 3 to 5, 7, 7א, 9 or 10 of חוק איסור הונאה בכשרות is up to one year's imprisonment (§14). (סעיף 14).
claims.raw_snippet: דינו – מאסר שנה.

claims.claim: A holder of a kashrut certificate must display it in a visible place at the place of business, and may display it only while it is in force (§10). (סעיף 10).

claims.claim: After תיקון מס' 5 (ס"ח תשפ"ו, 778, 19 July 2026), for a בית אוכל the kashrut certificate is given by the local rabbi serving where it is located or by מועצת הרבנות הראשית, and where no local rabbi serves, by a rabbi the Council authorised.
claims.raw_snippet: לעניין בית אוכל, מקום שחיטה או מקום הייצור של מצרך או של מוצר – רב מקומי המכהן במקום שבו הם נמצאים או מועצת הרבנות הראשית

claims.claim: An offence under חוק רישוי עסקים §14 is one of strict liability (§14(ד)), and a court may order the business's operation stopped or the premises closed (§16, §17). An administrative stop order may be issued under §20. (סעיף 14, סעיף 14א2, סעיף 16, סעיף 17, סעיף 20).

claims.claim: Tips given to waiters in restaurants, cafes and bars are considered part of their wage and must appear on the payslip; their inclusion affects Bituach Leumi, pension and income tax. At event halls and gardens tips are not treated as part of the wage.
